paragraphs: Mentioned with Rav Dosti at the end of Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, Rani Akarah, in the name of R' Levi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פסדר״כ ס״פ רני עקרה is read contextually as Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, end of the Rani Akarah section, without a modern piska number or independently checked named edition.

עם רב דוסתי בשם ר׳ לוי gives together with Rav Dosti, in Levi’s name, without separately specifying the relation between the two reporters or whether the attribution governs both. That ambiguity is retained. Dosti’s Rav is full; Yose and Levi remain R'.
